title: C54 fixed-Go dynacast reference/SR JSONL row, schema 1
description: Exactly 90 JSONL rows, case_id 0..89. Nested order: codec_mode [h264-simulcast,vp9-svc], reference [0,1,2], max_spatial [-1,0,2], report [none,wrong-layer,matching-zero,matching-valid,premature-zero]. No headers, expected values, cache reads or non-JSON stdout. All observations are public fixed-Go getters. ForceLayerForTest sets current/target only; GetTranslationParams on a real testutils RTP packet establishes reference. The Rust reader explicitly initializes max_spatial=-1 before subscription settings to match the bare Go Forwarder; constructor defaults are not compared. Its Started adapter uses the persistent video output clock and excludes dummy or seeded starts. This is not allocator/MAIN/SDP/SRTP/decoder evidence.

reference.description: First packet's spatial argument to GetTranslationParams, not the SR buffer index. VP9 SVC uses MULTIPLE_SPATIAL_LAYERS_PER_STREAM; reference 2 remains 2 even though getRefLayer uses SR buffer 0.

report_layer.description: none=-1 (no setter call), wrong-layer=(reference+1)%3, otherwise reference. matching-zero/premature-zero use non-nil all-zero RTCPSenderReportState. wrong-layer/matching-valid use NTP 0xe900000000000000, RTP=extRTP=93000. premature-zero occurs after constructor/DetermineCodec/SetMaxSpatialLayer(2), before ForceLayerForTest and first packet.

observations.description: Exact stage order is given in x-stage-operations. Each stage queries after the listed operations. The Rust reader should validate all scenario fields, order, row count, stage count and every observation, reject unknown/missing fields, and write its independently observed rows to a fresh output file. reference_spatial is JSON null only when GetState returns nil; after Restart it is integer -1 with started=true. All layer values are signed integers.

x-stage-operations: NewForwarder(video, logger, skipReferenceTS=false, disableOpportunisticAllocation=true, enableStartAtDesiredQuality=true, rtpStats=nil); DetermineCodec(H264 or VP9, 90000Hz, no extensions, corresponding layer mode)
SetMaxSpatialLayer(2); for premature-zero only, SetRefSenderReport(report_layer, non-nil zero SR)
ForceLayerForTest(reference, temporal=0); GetTranslationParams(testutils packet seq=1, timestamp=93000, SSRC=1000+reference, PT=96, marker/keyframe=true, reference)
SetRefSenderReport for wrong-layer/matching-zero/matching-valid; none/premature-zero do nothing
Restart(); does not reconstruct the object or call DetermineCodec again
SetRefSenderReport(reference, non-nil zero SR), leaving reference and SR in the old object
Replace with a new Forwarder and DetermineCodec; SetMaxSpatialLayer(scenario.max_spatial); no reports or state copied
